desc.en: It is recommended to break the fast with legally earned food, especially dates. This act doubles the reward of the prayer to 400 folds. It is also advisable to break the fast with dates, ripe dates, candy, sugar-candy, and cool water.
desc.rurdu: Namaz Isha ke baad iftar karna mustahab hai magar yeh keh kamzori ziyadah ho ya iftar mein koi shakhs uska muntazir (intezaar karta) ho. Haraam aur mashkuk cheezo’n se iftaar na kare, bal keh iske liye halaal o paakeeza cheeze’n istemaal kare. Halaal khurma se iftaar kare ta keh uski namaz ka sawaab 400 guna ho jaaye. Paani, taaza khajur aur doodh, halwa aur garam paani mein se jis cheez se iftaar kare behtar hai.

desc.en: A hadith reads, “Almighty Allah releases from Hell fire one million persons at the last hour of every day in Ramadan; therefore, pray Almighty Allah to include you with these released ones.”
desc.rurdu: Riwaayat mein hai keh Mahe Ramazan ki har shaam ek lakh (100,000) insaano ko Jahannam ki aag se azaad kiya jaata hai, lehaaza khud ke liye dua kare keh woh bhi un mein se ek ho.

desc.en: It is recommended to give alms at the time of breaking the fast and to offer food to the other fasters even if with a single date and a drink of water. Concerning this, the Holy Prophet (s) is reported to have said, “Verily, anyone who offers food for a faster in Ramadan will have the same reward that is decided for the faster without having any amount of his reward reduced and will have the same reward of acting good deeds according to the power of that food.”
desc.rurdu: Iftaar ke waqt sadaqa de aur digar momeneen ko iftaar karaaye chaahe chand khajure’n ya paani se hi kyu’n na ho. Rasoole Khuda (s) se riwaayat hai keh jo shakhs kisi ko iftaar karaaye to usko bhi roze-daar ke bara-bar sawaab milega jab keh us roze-daar ke sawaab mein kuchh kami na hogi. Neez is taam (khaane) se iftaar karne waala jo neki karega uska sawaab iftaar karne waale ko bhi milega.

desc.en: Allamah al-Hilli, in al-Risalah al-Sa’diyyah, has narrated that Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a) said, “As for any believer who feeds another believer with a single bite of food in Ramadan, Almighty Allah will decide for him the reward of manumitting thirty believing slaves and will decide to respond to his prayers.”
desc.rurdu: Allama Hilli ne Risaala Saadiya mein Imam Sadiq (a) se naql kiya hai keh Hazrat (a) ne farmaya: Jo shakhs apne momin bhai ko iftaar karaaye usko 30 ghulaam azaad karne ka sawaab milega aur Khuda ke yahan uski ek dua bhi bhi qabool hogi.
